detail: Jio Content Distribution Holdings Private Limited submitted a copy of its disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE. This disclosure is required when an acquirer crosses prescribed shareholding thresholds (typically 5% and multiples thereof) in a listed company. The filing against Hathway Cable & Datacom, a prominent cable and broadband operator, signals strategic interest in the broadcast/distribution segment.
